Test Case Description: Verify all refresh tokens are revoked after successful password change
PreRequisites:
- User is logged in on multiple devices (Browser A, Browser B, Mobile App)
- Each device has a valid refresh token in REFRESH_TOKENS table
- Current password: Password123!
Steps to Perform: In Browser A: Navigate to Change Password page
Test Case Expected Result: All refresh tokens are deleted from database after password change. User is forced to re-login on all other devices.

Step Expected Result: Query REFRESH_TOKENS table: all entries for user are deleted

Steps to Perform: In Browser B: Attempt to use old refresh token to get new access token
Verify forced logout on other devices
Step Expected Result:
- Browser B refresh token is invalid (not found in database)
- API returns 401 Unauthorized: 'Invalid refresh token'
- Browser B is forced to redirect to login page
- Mobile App also cannot refresh token
- Only Browser A (where password was changed) remains logged in with new access token
